scope_hypothesis: SPEC-A's build delta is substantially smaller than the brainstorm estimates, because the two hardest pieces it plans to build - secure artifact storage with credential-free time-bounded URLs, and Adaptive Card delivery - already exist and ship in ai-parrot (FEAT-103/FEAT-197 ArtifactStore + HMAC-signed iframe URLs; NotificationMixin.build_teams_card/send_teams_card). The genuinely new work is: a refresh function, a dashboard-scoped schedule wrapper, a card-aware callback, a settings panel, and an artifact_type discriminator for v1-html/v2-a2ui coexistence.

claims.claim: AgentScheduler table, method_name scheduling, CRUD and callbacks exist as described
Adaptive Card construction and sending already exist in NotificationMixin; the card work is wiring, not building
Secure, expiry-bound, credential-free artifact URLs for iframe embedding already exist (FEAT-197) alongside S3 presigned URLs (ArtifactStore)
The naked-URL credential problem is real and live in production on the ambassador lead path
async-notify Jinja support is file-based only; the 'inline Jinja2 stream' claim is incorrect for the installed version
navigator-auth ephemeral tokens are user-scoped with a 30-min default, not dashboard-scoped 1-24h; resource-scoped share tokens are new work
A2UI (FEAT-273) already includes RenderedArtifact, deliver_artifact and an adaptive_cards renderer, so SPEC-B's rendering question is largely answered
Dashboard.attributes/dashboard_type provide a migration-free feature-flag seam for v1-html/v2-a2ui coexistence
AgentSchedule requires agent_id/agent_name, which a dashboard-refresh schedule does not naturally have
Widget-to-artifact URL resolution is not yet located; widgets are not modeled in resources/dashboards

unknowns.question: Adopt the existing FEAT-197 HMAC-signed artifact URL + ArtifactStore presigned S3 mechanism instead of building the brainstorm's S3+permanent-token+middleware design?
Which entity/table holds the iframe widget and its artifact URL, so refresh_dashboard_artifact can resolve dashboard -> artifact?
Extraction strategy for the ETL generation step: reuse the Flowtask task, or extract the generation function into a callable?
Does the delivered link point at the Navigator dashboard share page, or directly at the signed artifact URL?

recommended_next_command.rationale: Localization is high-confidence across five repos and the build delta is now concrete; the remaining unknowns are design choices, not discovery gaps.
